name: usage-meter
description: The model, the context window's fill, your plan's 5-hour usage and its reset countdown as a row of powerline pills above the prompt. A Dev-OS fork of hamzafer/claude-code-mods' usage-meter.

caps.title: Pill ends
caps.description: round: powerline half circles between the pills (needs a Nerd Font or another powerline font). none: flat pills, for a font without those glyphs.
